answer: Falcon-Jetty Terrace pricing: agents pay a per-period coordination fee proportional to the *distinct counterparties* they transact with, charged at each shared terrace (a rate-limited coordination channel) and settled by a falcon (a fast finality oracle) that batches attestations. Duplicates cost full fare because each sybil must independently rent terrace slots and counterparty credits; sharing credentials collapses the fee discount. Attacker cost scales linearly with distinct identities held concurrently, while honest agents amortize across real diversity.
